hint_local_image_formula: A local JPG is selected: both image fields use its path. Excel IMAGE supports HTTPS only and cannot display local files; use the path field to export the file address.
hint_profile_open: Returns to the last saved product page for this domain and activates the profile. If no product address is saved, it opens the site's home page.
hint_help_mode: Beginner shows explanations and examples beside settings. Pro hides explanatory text while keeping values, actions and messages. The choice applies to all sites.
hint_language: Language changes only the extension interface. Product names, SKUs and your manual edits are not translated.
hint_opacity: 0% fully shows the background image; 100% hides it. This changes only the panel, not the saved JPG.
hint_accent: Click the color to change borders, field text and picker cursors. This applies to all sites.
hint_local_image: First set the folder, size and subfolders. Return to the product and drag around the image using the cursor with a square; the JPG uses the ready name from the panel.
hint_styles: A style saves the copy layout for all sites. Duplicate it for a new layout; reset clears its cells, and export creates a separate style file.
hint_separator: Tab places values in columns; Enter places them in rows. Space creates one text; ASCII sets a custom separator by its numeric code.
hint_excel_columns: Choose each cell's content: for example, A — name, B — SKU. Leave unchanged skips a destination, Any Text adds literal text, and + joins adjacent fields.
hint_blacklist: Example: add “Product code:” on its own line to remove that label from values. Changes save automatically for the current site only.
hint_profiles: A profile holds site-specific rules; a style holds the copy layout for all sites. Save profile remembers rules, and JSON export backs them up.
hint_formatting: Checkboxes choose the parts of the ready name and how its text is cleaned. Check the preview before copying.
hint_extraction: If automatic detection is wrong, pick an element with the cursor or choose a source below. Save the profile to reuse these rules on other products from this site.
hint_source_auto: The extension looks for this value in the page data and text.
hint_source_jsonld: Reads product metadata. If the site does not provide it, choose another source.
hint_source_css: A CSS selector identifies the page element; the picker fills it automatically.
hint_source_attribute: Choose the element and attribute, for example src for an image URL or content for metadata.
hint_source_regex: Searches with a pattern; put the required value in the first (...) capture group.
hint_source_url: Enter the URL parameter name: for ?sku=123 enter sku.
hint_source_manual: The entered value is the same for every product using this profile.
local_image_full_path_needed: The browser provided only the folder name. To show the full path, paste it with Ctrl+V in path settings and confirm the folder.
color_of_borders_field_text_and_pickers: Color of borders, field text and pickers
ascii_code_must_be_from_1_to_127: ASCII code must be from 1 to 127.
field_separator_and_formatting_settings_: Field, separator, and formatting settings are saved automatically in the selected style.
enter_a_valid_bar_rod_length: Enter a valid bar / rod length.
check_and_confirm_the_bar_rod_length_bef: Check and confirm the bar / rod length before copying.
specify_the_material_unit_of_measure: Specify the material unit of measure.
for_excel_full_description_unit_price: For Excel: full description · unit · price
multiple_articles_choose_the_correct_one: Multiple articles — choose the correct one
paste_blocks_separately_into_the_same_ro: Paste blocks separately into the same row. Skipped columns are not copied.
column_settings_are_saved_automatically_: Column settings are saved automatically for your database. Select the indicated cell in Excel yourself.
choose_a_separate_column_from_a_to_z_for: Choose a separate column from A to Z for each field.
for_this_site_one_phrase_per_line_saved_: For this site. One phrase per line. Saved automatically; matches are exact and case-sensitive.
saved_for_this_site_text_is_removed_from: Saved for this site. Text is removed from fields automatically.
product_name_not_found_configure_the_fie: Product name not found — configure the field.
article_not_found_configure_the_field: Article not found — configure the field.
excel_requires_a_unit_and_a_valid_price: Excel requires a unit and a valid price.
choose_the_correct_price_and_unit_or_edi: Choose the correct price and unit, or edit them manually.
reload_the_page_and_try_again: Reload the page and try again.
the_clipboard_document_did_not_confirm_c: The clipboard document did not confirm copying.
supplier_clipboard_means_a_clipboard_for: Supplier Clipboard means a clipboard for supplier data. The extension collects product details from a store page and prepares them for pasting into CAD or Excel.
a_dedicated_support_topic_has_not_been_c: A dedicated support topic has not been created yet; this link opens the supplied Yurms group topic.
open_last_used_page_and_activate_profile: Open last used page and activate profile
open_this_domain_s_website_to_apply_the_: Open this domain's website to apply the profile.
domains_the_number_in_parentheses_is_the: Domains: {count}. The number in parentheses is the profile count, including disabled profiles.
delete_all_profiles_for_domain_recovery_: Delete all profiles for domain {domain} ({count})? Recovery requires a previously exported JSON file.
in_enter_mode_the_layout_defines_rows_1_: In Enter mode the layout defines rows 1–26 instead of columns A–Z. Place fields consecutively for a single paste. Paste into a selected cell, not while editing it.
enter_mode_values_are_pasted_downwards_s: Enter mode: values are pasted downwards. Sessions: {count}; rows: {targets}. Select the starting cell of each block in the same column. Skipped rows remain unchanged.
local_image_path: Base folder — paste a path with Ctrl+V
local_image_path_note: For a new path, click Choose folder and confirm that folder. Browser access requires the system picker; the browser does not expose the full path, so paste it manually.
local_image_subfolder_note: Example: Catalog/{supplier}. Folders are created inside the base folder; {supplier} is replaced with the supplier from the panel.
local_image_size_contain: Fit entire image — pad with background
local_image_size_note: Aspect ratio is always preserved. Fit uses the smaller scale and background padding. Fill uses the larger scale and a centered crop. Size: 1–8192 px, up to 32 million pixels.
local_image_confirm_path: Confirm the pasted path using Choose folder.
local_image_folder_mismatch: The selected folder name does not match the pasted path. Choose the intended folder or correct the path.
local_image_invalid_size: Enter whole dimensions from 1 to 8192 px, at most 32 million pixels total.
local_image_invalid_subfolder: Enter relative subfolders without a drive, leading /, .. or forbidden characters.
local_image_supplier_required: Enter the supplier in the panel for the subfolder.
local_image_return_unavailable: Settings saved. Product tab was not found — return to it manually.
local_image_folder_description: Choose a local folder for JPG files. The cursor with a square saves a selected area of the visible page using the ready product name. No URL is needed. Existing filenames receive a number.
choose_local_image_folder_first: Choose a folder or restore access in Local image settings.
local_image_folder_ready: Folder is ready. Return to the product and click the cursor with a square.
local_image_folder_not_supported: This browser does not support local folder selection. Use a current Chrome or Edge.
local_image_busy: Wait for the image to finish saving.
invalid_capture_region: Invalid capture area. Select a rectangle on the visible page.
capture_tab_not_active: Return to the product tab and select the area again.
select_local_image_region: Local image: drag a rectangle around the image. Esc — cancel.
pick_local_image_region: Local image — select an area and save JPG
pick_the_product_image_on_the_page: Pick the product image on the page
for_image_urls_insert_the_image_url_form: For image URLs, insert the =IMAGE("URL") formula
0_makes_the_image_fully_visible_100_hide: 0% makes the image fully visible; 100% hides it behind the background.
image_url_was_not_found_configure_the_fi: Image URL was not found — configure the field.
enter_a_valid_price_for_the_selected_col: Enter a valid price for the selected column.
join_with_a_space_must_be_between_two_fi: Join with a space must be between two fields.
select_at_least_one_field_to_copy_to_exc: Select at least one field to copy to Excel.
selected_columns_require_a_unit_and_a_va: Selected columns require a unit and a valid price.
fill_in_for_the_selected_column: Fill in “{field}” for the selected column.
choose_a_field_or_leave_unchanged_for_ea: Choose a field or “Leave unchanged” for each column. Fields may be repeated. Scroll right to configure columns through Z.
one_copy_session_copy_once_and_paste_int: One copy session — {target}. Copy once and paste into column {column}: all selected fields will be filled in a single paste.
adjacent_columns_are_combined_into_one_c: Adjacent columns are combined into one copy session. Gaps create separate sessions. The layout is saved automatically; you select the starting cell in Excel.
copy_sessions_copy_each_block_in_order_a: Copy sessions: {count} — {targets}. Copy each block in order and paste into its starting column in the same row. Skipped cells remain unchanged.
one_copy_session_copy_once_and_paste_int: One copy session — {target}. Copy once and paste into column {column}: all three fields will be filled in a single paste.
enter_a_valid_sheet_length_and_width: Enter a valid sheet length and width.
check_and_confirm_sheet_dimensions_befor: Check and confirm sheet dimensions before copying.
update_available_details: A newer version of the extension has been published on GitHub.
hint_avc_properties: Fields B, C, K and L differ between products. Edit them here or add an extraction rule below; a typed value is remembered for this domain.
